Which semantic models are available in S:
SELECT
    semantic_model_name,
    workspace_name,
    storage_mode,
    latest_analysis_status,
    latest_analysis_at,
    scanner_version
FROM semantic_model_metadata.semantic_models
ORDER BY
    workspace_name,
    semantic_model_name;
Show me the latest scan execution status:
WITH ranked_runs AS
(
    SELECT
        semantic_model_id,
        semantic_model_name,
        workspace_name,
        analysis_id,
        analysis_status,
        permission_precheck_status,
        started_at,
        completed_at,
        duration_seconds,
        error_details,
        scanner_version,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY semantic_model_id
            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(completed_at, started_at) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM analysis_control.semantic_model_analysis_runs
)
SELECT
    semantic_model_name,
    workspace_name,
    analysis_status,
    permission_precheck_status,
    started_at,
    completed_at,
    duration_seconds,
    error_details,
    scanner_version
FROM ranked_runs
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY
    completed_at DESC;
Which recent semantic model scans failed:
SELECT TOP (20)
    semantic_model_name,
    workspace_name,
    analysis_status,
    permission_precheck_status,
    best_practice_analysis_status,
    storage_analysis_status,
    refresh_history_status,
    direct_lake_analysis_status,
    started_at,
    completed_at,
    duration_seconds,
    error_details
FROM analysis_control.semantic_model_analysis_runs
WHERE analysis_status <> 'SUCCEEDED'
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(completed_at, started_at) DESC;

Show the highest-priority optimization o:
SELECT TOP (20)
    o.semantic_model_name,
    o.workspace_name,
    o.opportunity_title,
    o.optimization_domain,
    o.priority_band AS opportunity_priority_band,
    o.priority_score AS opportunity_priority_score,
    o.actionability_status AS opportunity_actionability,
    r.recommendation_title,
    r.recommended_action,
    r.recommendation_priority_band,
    r.recommendation_priority_score,
    r.change_risk,
    r.validation_method
FROM semantic_model_optimization.semantic_model_optimization_opportunities AS o
LEFT JOIN semantic_model_optimization.semantic_model_optimization_recommendations AS r
    ON  r.semantic_model_id = o.semantic_model_id
    AND r.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
WHERE o.actionability_status IN ('ACTIONABLE', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED')
ORDER BY
    o.priority_score DESC,
    r.recommendation_priority_score DESC;

Which Best Practice Analyzer rules are t:
SELECT TOP (20)
    rule_name,
    category,
    severity,
    COUNT(*) AS finding_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT semantic_model_id) AS affected_semantic_model_count
FROM semantic_model_best_practice.semantic_model_best_practice_rule_findings
GROUP BY
    rule_name,
    category,
    severity
ORDER BY
    finding_count DESC;

Which Best Practice Analyzer rules are t:
SELECT TOP (20)
    b.rule_name,
    b.category,
    b.severity,
    COUNT(*) AS finding_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.semantic_model_id) AS affected_semantic_model_count
FROM semantic_model_best_practice.semantic_model_best_practice_rule_findings AS b
WHERE EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM semantic_model_metadata.semantic_models AS m
    WHERE m.semantic_model_id = b.semantic_model_id
)
GROUP BY
    b.rule_name,
    b.category,
    b.severity
ORDER BY
    finding_count DESC;

For Video Game Sales, show the top actio:
WITH top_recommendations AS
(
    SELECT TOP (20)
        recommendation_id,
        opportunity_id,
        analysis_id,
        analysis_scope_key,
        issue_scope_key,
        semantic_model_id,
        semantic_model_name,
        workspace_name,
        recommendation_title,
        optimization_domain,
        recommended_action,
        recommendation_priority_band,
        recommendation_priority_score,
        actionability_status,
        change_risk
    FROM semantic_model_optimization.semantic_model_optimization_recommendations
    WHERE semantic_model_name = 'Video Game Sales'
      AND actionability_status = 'ACTIONABLE'
    ORDER BY
        recommendation_priority_score DESC
)
SELECT
    r.workspace_name,
    r.semantic_model_name,
    r.recommendation_title,
    r.optimization_domain,
    r.recommendation_priority_band,
    r.recommendation_priority_score,
    r.change_risk,
    r.recommended_action,
    f.rule_name,
    f.severity,
    f.affected_object_type,
    f.display_table_name,
    f.display_object_name,
    f.finding_description,
    f.technical_evidence
FROM top_recommendations AS r
LEFT JOIN semantic_model_optimization.semantic_model_optimization_findings AS f
    ON  f.semantic_model_id = r.semantic_model_id
    AND f.analysis_id = r.analysis_id
    AND f.analysis_scope_key = r.analysis_scope_key
    AND f.issue_scope_key = r.issue_scope_key
    AND f.opportunity_id = r.opportunity_id
ORDER BY
    r.recommendation_priority_score DESC,
    r.recommendation_title,
    f.finding_priority_score DESC;
